overview: A customer fee tracker for recording each customer's name, mobile number, paid fees, due fees, and total fees, with a live summary dashboard.
features: Add customers with name, mobile number, paid fees, due fees, and total fees
Total fees auto-calculates from paid plus due and can be overridden
Search customers by name or mobile number
Sort and filter to find customers with outstanding dues
Dashboard cards showing total customers, collected, due, and billed
Edit and delete customer records with confirmation
Works as a phone app and can be added to the Android home screen
